image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a dark-shelled turtle (likely a mud or musk turtle) moving through grassy terrain. The turtle has a high-domed, smooth, dark carapace with some light scratches or debris. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small lateral eye. One forelimb is clearly visible, appearing stout with webbed toes and claws. The skin is dark and textured. The background is blurred natural foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visible in profile. The snout is distinctly pointed, the eye is small and located on the side of the head, and the head proportion appears large relative to the neck thickness, matching the description.
